evals.prompt: Add tests for the campaigns endpoints. The router lives at backend/app/routers/campaigns.py and is registered in backend/app/main.py at the prefix /campaigns. Use the project's existing testing conventions.
evals.expected_output: A new pytest test file (or additions to an existing one) that exercises the GET /campaigns route. Tests should match the project style (FastAPI TestClient, plain functions with assert). Should account for the lazy-DB pattern where /campaigns may return 503 when DATABASE_URL is unset.

evals.prompt: Our backend test suite is pretty thin — see backend/tests/. Look at what we have, look at the rest of the backend, and add the most impactful missing tests. Don't try to cover everything; pick the highest-leverage gaps and explain what you chose.
evals.expected_output: New tests covering high-value gaps (likely: route coverage for endpoints without tests, schema/validation tests, the lazy-DB 503 path, the RuntimeError->503 exception handler). Includes a brief written summary of what was added and why, and what was deliberately deferred.

evals.prompt: I want to make sure our backend API returns the right HTTP responses when things go wrong. Add tests that cover the error/edge-case behavior of our endpoints — wrong methods, bad input, missing resources, the lazy-DB 503 fallback. Keep them runnable with the project's existing pytest setup.
evals.expected_output: Tests targeting error paths: 404/405/422 where applicable, the documented 503 when the database isn't configured, and any other edge cases visible in the current code (e.g. unknown routes, malformed paths). Should run cleanly with `uv run pytest` against the current code without modifying production code.
